# What html cannot answer of sngl:ui/nav is refused where it is written,
# rather than written out as a page nobody can reach.
#
# A page's params travel in its path, so a field its href names no placeholder
# for has nowhere to travel. A static site writes one document per page: a page
# whose href names a placeholder is a pattern no file can be, so a page there
# has no params at all, and nothing can hand it any. Two pages one request
# could reach are the conflict two windows already are, and two pages at one
# path on a static site are one file.
#
# A window's documents are its pages, so it holds one stack, holds it where a
# document can be decided -- not under an `if` that reads state -- and has no
# href of its own beside them.

! sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o out pattern.sngl
stderr 'pattern.sngl:12:22: page "pkg" is served at /p/\{name\}, a pattern: a static site writes one document per page and cannot serve one; compile with a server language \(e.g. --lang go\)'

! sngl generate --platform html --lang go -o out unnamed.sngl
stderr 'unnamed.sngl:13:22: page "pkg"''s params have a field "kind" its href /p/\{name\} names no placeholder for; a page''s params travel in its path'

! sngl generate --platform html --lang go -o out conflict.sngl
stderr 'html: page "a" and page "b" both serve /p/\{id\}'

! sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o out samepath.sngl
stderr 'html: page "b" is written to about/index.html, as page "a" is'

! sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o out twostacks.sngl
stderr 'twostacks.sngl:12:12: a window''s documents are its pages, and this is a second nav.stack in it; the first is at twostacks.sngl:7:12'

! sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o out windowhref.sngl
stderr 'windowhref.sngl:4:10: a window holding a nav.stack is served at its pages'' hrefs, and this one has an href of its own'

! sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o out underif.sngl
stderr 'underif.sngl:9:16: a nav.stack under an `if` that reads state cannot be decided per document; write the `if` inside a page'

-- pattern.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Pkg {
    name string
}

ui.window(title="Pattern") {
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page #home(href="/", title="Home") {
        }
        nav.page #pkg(href=`/p/{name}`, title="Package", params=Pkg{name="first"}) {
        }
    }
}
-- unnamed.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Pkg {
    name string
    kind string
}

ui.window(title="Unnamed") {
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page #home(href="/", title="Home") {
        }
        nav.page #pkg(href=`/p/{name}`, title="Package", params=Pkg{name="first"}) {
        }
    }
}
-- conflict.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct ByName {
    name string
}

struct ById {
    id string
}

ui.window(title="Conflict") {
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page #a(href=`/p/{name}`, title="A", params=ByName{}) {
        }
        nav.page #b(href=`/p/{id}`, title="B", params=ById{}) {
        }
    }
}
-- samepath.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

ui.window(title="Same") {
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page #a(href="/about", title="A") {
        }
        nav.page #b(href="/about/", title="B") {
        }
    }
}
-- twostacks.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

ui.window(title="Two") {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text(value="x")
        nav.stack #left {
            nav.page #a(href="/", title="A") {
            }
        }
        ui.text(value="y")
        nav.stack #right {
            nav.page #b(href="/b", title="B") {
            }
        }
    }
}
-- windowhref.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

ui.window(title="Href", href="/app") {
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page #a(href="/", title="A") {
        }
    }
}
-- underif.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var shown = true

ui.window(title="If") {
    ui.vbox {
        if shown {
            nav.stack #pages {
                nav.page #a(href="/", title="A") {
                }
            }
        }
        ui.button(text="Toggle", @click {
            shown = !shown
        })
    }
}
